The '''Doormaker''' was a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} found in {{2|Glory}}. The fight starts with the '''Doormaker''' appearing as the Door with infinite health. It then transforms into the '''Doormaker''' on its first turn. 

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Doormaker}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Dramatic Open
|Intent = Summon
|Effect = Transforms into the Doormaker. Sets current buff to {{BD2|Hunger}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Hunger
|NoStore = yes
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Hunger
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (30;{{Asc2|9|35}}) damage. Swaps current buff to {{BD2|Scrutiny}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Scrutiny
|NoStore = yes
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Scrutiny
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (24;{{Asc2|9|26}}) damage. Swaps current buff to {{BD2|Grasp}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Grasp
|NoStore = yes
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Grasp
|Intent = Attack4, Buff
|Effect = Deals (10x2;{{Asc2|9|11x2}}) damage. Gains 3 {{BD2|Strength}}. Swaps current buff to {{BD2|Hunger}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength, Hunger
|NoStore = yes
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Doormaker uses {{Int2|Doormaker|Dramatic Open}} on its first turn, then follows a repeating cycle:
# {{Int2|Doormaker|Hunger}}
# {{Int2|Doormaker|Scrutiny}}
# {{Int2|Doormaker|Grasp}}

== Notes ==
* Even though the HP bar in the first phase shows as "infinity", it is actually set to the finite number of 999,999,999 HP. As such, it is theoretically possible to kill the Doormaker in its first phase.

== Trivia ==
* The Doormaker was the third in a series of Act 3 boss reworks, starting with the Illusionist, then the Dreamer, then the Doormaker. Now he has been replaced with a 4th boss, {{M2|Aeonglass}}.
** Doormaker was removed because "While Doormaker had interesting micro decisions in the fight, he was over the complexity threshold of what we want and had lingering issues". In a later interview, a developer clarified that "Doormaker's 3 different phases also meant that it wasn't good at teaching a coherent lesson to the player, as it was too complicated for players to build a deck that could defeat all three phases." 
** There was also no clear feedback as on which phase was being problematic, with all 3 phases being criticized as being "too hard" by different players.<ref>https://youtu.be/8QBRmK4Ahk0?t=646</ref>
